'''P3-R1''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active in the aftermath of the [[war against Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] it was brought to [[Iokath]] to provide assistance during the the [[War on Iokath]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
P3-R1 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a vendor on Iokath for Republic-affiliated players.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
